items.exampleEn: Her astonishment was clear when she saw the price.
items.exampleZh: 她看到價格時，驚訝之情表露無遺。

items.exampleEn: The relieved parents hugged their lost son.
items.exampleZh: 鬆了一口氣的父母緊緊抱住走失的兒子。

items.exampleEn: The benevolent king gave food to the poor every winter.
items.exampleZh: 仁慈的國王每年冬天都會發食物給窮人。

items.exampleEn: Only a coward would run away and leave his friend behind.
items.exampleZh: 只有懦夫才會丟下朋友逃跑。

items.exampleEn: The ad was deceptive because the real phone was much smaller.
items.exampleZh: 那則廣告有誤導性，因為實際的手機小得多。

items.exampleEn: The coach put inspirational quotes on the walls of the gym.
items.exampleZh: 教練在健身房的牆上貼了激勵人心的名言。

items.exampleEn: "Are we there yet?" the kids asked impatiently.
items.exampleZh: 「我們到了沒？」孩子們不耐煩地問。

items.exampleEn: Stop being so childish and say sorry to your sister.
items.exampleZh: 別那麼幼稚了，去跟你的姊妹道歉。

items.sentenceEn: The children waited impatiently for the cake to be cut.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們迫不及待地等著切蛋糕。

items.audioEn: I was relieved when my lost wallet came back with all the money still inside.
items.audioZh: 我弄丟的錢包被送回來，裡面的錢一毛不少，我才鬆了一口氣。
items.questionZh: 說話者的錢包後來怎麼了？
options: It was returned, money and all
It was stolen by a thief
It came back with nothing inside
It is still missing after a week

items.sentenceEn: Her story about building a school in her village is truly inspirational.
items.sentenceZh: 她在村裡蓋學校的故事真的很鼓舞人心。

items.sentenceEn: The calm sea is deceptive; the currents here are very strong.
items.sentenceZh: 平靜的海面會騙人，這裡的海流其實非常強。

items.stemEn: He called his friend a ____ for being afraid to jump into the pool.
items.stemZh: 他朋友不敢跳進泳池，他就罵朋友是膽小鬼。

items.stemEn: It's ____ to scream when you lose a game; you're not five years old!
items.stemZh: 輸了遊戲就尖叫很幼稚，你又不是五歲小孩！

items.passageEn: When I was ten, I was a real coward. I was afraid of dogs, the dark and even speaking in class. Then a new teacher arrived. She was benevolent and patient, and she never made me feel childish. One day, to my astonishment, she asked me to read my story aloud to the whole school. I was shaking, but when I finished, everyone clapped. I was so relieved. Her belief in me was truly inspirational.
items.passageZh: 我十歲時是個十足的膽小鬼。我怕狗、怕黑，甚至怕在課堂上發言。後來來了一位新老師。她仁慈又有耐心，從來不讓我覺得自己很幼稚。有一天，出乎我意料，她要我在全校面前朗讀我寫的故事。我一直發抖，但讀完時大家都鼓掌了。我真是鬆了一口氣。她對我的信任真的很激勵人心。

questions.questionZh: 作者讀完故事後，大家有什麼反應？

items.promptZh: 別這麼快就相信他，外表是會騙人的。
referenceEn: Don't trust him so quickly; appearances can be deceptive.
Don't believe him so fast, because looks can be deceptive.
rubricZh: 要用 deceptive（例如 appearances can be deceptive）

items.promptZh: 老師聽到全班都平安到家，鬆了一口氣。
referenceEn: The teacher was relieved to hear that the whole class got home safely.
The teacher felt relieved after hearing that everyone in the class had arrived home safely.
rubricZh: relieved 當形容詞，接在 be 動詞或 feel 後（例如 was relieved、felt relieved 等）
「聽到…」可寫，例如 to hear that…、after hearing…、when he/she heard… 等
「平安到家」可寫，例如 got home safely、arrived home safely 等
